headline: Man United transfer strategy 'financial sustainable' as losses increase - CEO
description: Manchester United's summer transfer strategy had "financial sustainability in mind," according to CEO Omar Berrada, after reporting a increased financial losses.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Could Bayern sign Haaland to replace Kane?
description: Erling Haaland is contracted to Manchester City for another eight years, but could Bayern Munich sign him? Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Liverpool close to appointing Julian Ward as sporting director - sources
description: Liverpool are closing in on the appointment of Julian Ward as the club's new sporting director, sources told ESPN.

headline: Sources: Mikel Arteta agrees a new long-term contract extension with Arsenal
description: Arsenal are expected to announce Mikel Arteta has signed a new long-term contract after the 44-year-old agreed terms to stay on as manager, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Sunderland penalty against Arsenal incorrect - Premier League panel
description: A penalty award strongly contested by Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta at Sunderland was incorrect, according to a unanimous decision from a Premier League panel.

headline: Joseph Yobo backs Alex Iwobi to break Ahmed Musa's Nigeria appearance record
description: Former Nigeria captain Joseph Yobo believes Alex Iwobi can push his international career beyond 130 appearances, after becoming only the fourth Super Eagles player to reach 100 caps.
